page_title: ACM 2-2 PIS | AC Milan v Pisa 24/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' A great run from Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
90+9' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+8' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is cleared away by the defence.
90+7' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. AC Milan have a free kick.
90+6' Luka Modric (AC Milan) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
90+6' Referee Luca Zufferli halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Alberto Gilardino, then shows him a yellow.
90+5' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) was probably a bit loose with his words to Luca Zufferli, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+5' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Zufferli signals. AC Milan earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+5' That's unlucky! Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

90+3' 2 - 2 Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) produces a wonderful finish! He received a pass from Luka Modric and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike into the bottom right corner via the post. The score is 2:2.
90+3' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) works the corner short.

90+3' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Adrian Semper easily makes the save.
89' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 8:18.
88' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Luca Zufferli to decide it wasn’t a foul. The relieved Pisa players can finally celebrate.
87' Wait! Referee Luca Zufferli has indicated he is going to review the Pisa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.

86' 1 - 2 M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) runs on to a clever pass from Ebenezer Akinsanmiro and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
84' Luka Modric (AC Milan) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
84' Isak Vural (Pisa) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
81' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
80' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) sends a long ball forward to M'Bala Nzola, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
79' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
76' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Santiago Tomas Gimenez will be replaced by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan).
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) coming on for Davide Bartesaghi.
75' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to find Santiago Tomas Gimenez, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
74' 15:6 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 5:1.
73' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
71' Here is a change. Matteo Tramoni is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Isak Vural (Pisa).
71' Substitution. Henrik Meister is replaced by Stefano Moreo (Pisa).
70' Davide Bartesaghi sends the ball into the centre of the box from the corner. Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) bursts through a crowd of players but heads the ball miles wide of the left post.
70' Corner kick. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is ready to send the ball into the box.

70' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the top right corner. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Adrian Semper and his brilliant save. The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

70' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the right side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
70' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
69' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. AC Milan force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' The game is interrupted now, Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' Luka Modric (AC Milan) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
65' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) makes a slide tackle, but referee Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. AC Milan win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
64' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was!
63' It could have been a good chance to score! Luka Modric (AC Milan) fails to release Strahinja Pavlovic with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
61' Great solo effort from Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mike Maignan into left side of the goal.
60' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
59' Referee Luca Zufferli is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Pisa!
58' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Pisa as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
57' The players claim that Koni De Winter (AC Milan) handled the ball and it seems they are right. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Pisa!
55' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
54' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. Good work from Pisa as they win a corner.
52' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
50' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) stretches for the loose ball inside the box and rifles a volley just wide of the left post.
49' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
47' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Raul Albiol (Pisa) is replaced by Arturo Calabresi.
46' Half-time substitution. Alberto Gilardino decided to make a change. Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) is replaced by Juan Cuadrado.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Luka Modric (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
44' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan).
42' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
40' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian Semper is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
38' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
38' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, AC Milan are going to take it.
37' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul after Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) hacks down one of his opponents.
33' 5:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
33' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
32' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) and Rafael Leao try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Michel Aebischer (Pisa) was quite harsh and Luca Zufferli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
28' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.

26' M'Bala Nzola almost found himself in a promising position after Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
25' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) receives a reproachful look from Michel Aebischer. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.

24' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Adrian Semper is equal to it and makes an easy save.
23' Luca Zufferli blows the whistle, Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) is penalised for a foul. AC Milan will take a free kick.
23' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
23' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
21' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

21' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
18' Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
18' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
18' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Pisa have a corner.
17' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) commits a foul and Luca Zufferli immediately signals a free kick.
16' The ball possession at the moment is 64:36.
16' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Zufferli who sees an offensive foul.

14' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Giovanni Bonfanti with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move. Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
13' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
12' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Adrian Semper punches the ball away.
10' The opposition give Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
10' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
9' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
9' No offside! Referee Luca Zufferli points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The AC Milan players celebrate.
8' Wait! Referee Luca Zufferli has indicated he is going to review the AC Milan goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
7' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
4' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and it's M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' AC Milan are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
2' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
1' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) sends a long ball in, but Adrian Semper comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli is the one to supervise the game today.
